summary: Added a JSON-producing final security readiness wrapper and surfaced the generated report in the Security CI artifact.
changes: Added scripts/security/write-final-readiness-report.mjs as a wrapper around npm run security:final-readiness.
Exposed npm run security:final-readiness:report in package.json.
Updated Security CI to generate final-security-readiness.json and include it in the npm-audit-triage artifact.
Updated supply-chain policy enforcement and documentation to protect the new report command.
remaining_blockers: Generate and commit package-lock.json with npm run supply-chain:lockfile.
Review npm-audit-triage artifact and apply targeted dependency fixes.
Replace floating dependency specs with exact audited versions.
Promote final readiness to blocking CI after blockers are resolved.
